title: Lifecycle-stable x1 assertion
failure_signature: An x1 test inferred separation from the future worktree absence of x2 paths, so a valid later lifecycle would make the historical x1 assertion fail.
trigger_preconditions: The same test module remains in the repository after x2 begins.
The test checks current path absence rather than immutable x1 truth and commit-local review evidence.
candidate_workaround: Assert the frozen x1 phase-truth flags and x1 staged-review x2 path count, which remain valid after later additive lifecycle files exist.
recurrence_guard: Historical lifecycle tests must read frozen receipts, never infer prior state from the current later worktree.
rollback: Restore the exact x1 test from its commit if the receipt-based assertion no longer matches the frozen evidence.
scope_boundary: The assertion mechanism only; the x1 commit and frozen x1 receipts remain unchanged.
